description_en: Modifies the elastic IP address (EIP) of a pilot instance
kebab_example: aliyun servicemesh modify-pilot-eip-resource --service-mesh-id c1f5a67154bec40629c2698ec00000000 --operation BindEip --eip-id eip-hp36jpqq5eged00000000 --is-canary false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPilotEipResource

parameters.help_en:
The operation to perform. Valid values:

`UnBindEip`: Detach an EIP.

`BindEip`: Attach an EIP
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型，取值：

`UnBindEip`：解绑EIP。

`BindEip`：绑定一个EIP
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Elastic IP Address (EIP) instance
parameters.help_zh: 需要绑定的弹性公网 IP 实例 Id
parameters.name: eip_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of pilot to which the EIP is attached. Valid values:

`true`: The EIP is attached to a canary pilot. This value is valid only during a canary release.

`false`: The EIP is attached to a stable pilot
parameters.help_zh:
绑定EIP的Pilot类型，取值：

`true`：为金丝雀Pilot绑定EIP（只在金丝雀升级过程中有效）。

`false`：为稳定版Pilot绑定EIP
parameters.name: is_canary
